question_or_proposition: Under Outfall 001 Part I WET requirements, how does the nominated 'Once/5 years' measurement frequency for Pimephales promelas combine with footnote (2) ('Perform WET testing at first discharge') and footnote (3) (Part II WET conditions) to determine whether Pimephales promelas chronic WET monitoring was required during Federal FY2025?
required_context: Part I Section A Outfall 001 WET table: Pimephales promelas row (VALUE: Report; MEASUREMENT FREQUENCY: Once/5 years; SAMPLE TYPE: 24-Hr Composite)
Footnote (2): Perform WET testing at first discharge
Footnote (3): Part II WET testing requirements and additional WET monitoring and reporting conditions
source_locator: page 4, section part_i, WET table, Pimephales promelas row, MEASUREMENT FREQUENCY column
notes: Purpose A is unaffected because the row's VALUE is Report rather than an enforceable numeric limit. Purposes B and C turn on whether the monitoring schedule established by 'Once/5 years' (as modified by footnotes (2) and (3)) required Pimephales promelas WET testing during FY2025, which determines applicability and the semantics of any absent WET result.
